name: 2,4-dinitrophenylmorphine
summary: 2,4-Dinitrophenylmorphine is an analog of morphine in which a hydroxyl group is substituted with a dinitro phenoxy group.

fact.en: Its 2,4-dinitrophenyl group is the same tag that Frederick Sanger used on proteins when he worked out the structure of insulin, work that won him a Nobel Prize.
fact.zh: 它的2,4-二硝基苯基正是Frederick Sanger在解出胰島素結構時用來標記蛋白質的基團，這項研究為他贏得諾貝爾獎。
fact.zhHans: 它的2,4-二硝基苯基正是Frederick Sanger在解出胰岛素结构时用来标记蛋白质的基团，这项研究为他赢得诺贝尔奖。
